RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, July 30, 2018/Shravana 8, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Defence; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Earth Sciences;
Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Information and
Broadcasting; Mines; Panchayati Raj; Road Transport and
Highways; Rural Development; Science and Technology;
Shipping; Water Resources, River Development and
Ganga Rejuvenation; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 15
India's performance in International
sports
*121. DR. KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's
performance in International sports is not
upto the mark;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the reasons for not overcoming the
obstacles; and
(d) the action plans proposed to bring
India to a respectable level in sports?
Budgetary provisions for defence
services
*122. SHRI P . BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the budgetary provisions
have been made, as per the current
requirements of various defence services,
in view of the challenges being faced by our
defence personnel;
(b) if so, the estimated requirements
under different heads; and
(c)  whether the funds allocated for the
current financial year are adequate and would
meet defence needs?
Wages under MGNREGS
†*123. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
YADA V: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that job card
holders are not getting sufficient amount of
work under Mahatma Gandhi National Rural
Employment Guarantee Scheme
(MGNREGS) in various States, including
Chhattisgarh and Uttar Pradesh;
(b) whether it is also a fact that labourers
are unable to get their wages in time, owing
to delayed payment being made under
MGNREGS in Chhattisgarh;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

44
(c) whether it is also a fact that
carelessness on the part of the local
administration in uploading information on
MGNREGS website in accordance with
its guidelines has led to disruption in timely
payment to the labourers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Permission to Indian channels to
telecast in the country
*124. SHRI A. VIJAYAKUMAR: Will
the Minister of  INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of Indian channels
have lost their permission to telecast in the
country;
(b) if so, the details of the channels and
the reasons for not granting permission;
and
(c) whether many of the channels are
using foreign transponders inspite of the
expiry of Government's deadline?
Implementation of NHARS
Scheme
*125. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has allocated
adequate funds for procurement of cranes,
ambulances and state of the art mobile
medical vans for effective relief and rescue
measures during the road accidents on
various National Highways in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the funds
allocated during the last three years under
National Highway Accident Relief Service
(NHARS) Scheme in Tamil Nadu; and
(c) the total length of various National
Highways in Tamil Nadu and the steps
taken by Government to reduce fatal
accidents in these NHs, during the last three
years, year-wise and NH-wise?
Deaths due to high carbon
emission
†*126. SHRI RAM NATH THAKUR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT,
FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
cities are witnessing an alarming increase in
the number of deaths due to high carbon
emission and vehicular pollution;
(b) whether Government is aware of
the media reports published recently,
stating that excessive carbon emission is
making air toxic; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to deal with this dangerous
situation?
Inter-linking of rivers
*127. DR. VIKAS MAHATME: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES,
RIVER DEVELOPMENT AND GANGA
REJUVENATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
inter-linking of rivers and if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether any feasibility report has
been prepared for intra-State river linking
in such cases and if so, the details thereof,
State-wise; and
(c) the impact of such intra-State linking
of rivers on the neighbouring States?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

45
Per capita availability of water
†*128. SHRIMATI CHHAYA
VERMA: Will the Minister of W A TER
RESOURCES, RIVER DEVELOPMENT
AND GANGA REJUVENATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of per capita availability
of water in the country and whether it is a
fact that it is declining in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that India is
one of the countries where water shortage
is acute and people struggle to get clean
drinking water even now;
(c) whether it is also a fact that water in
most of the Indian rivers is polluted; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

Total number of questions — 160

Setting up of Indian Defence
University
1281. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR:
SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up an Indian Defence University (IDU);
(b) if so, the progress and the present
status thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
set up IDUs in hilly States which are
situated on the border States such as
Himachal Pradesh; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Incidents of ceasefire violation along
Pakistan border
1282. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of incidents of ceasefire
violations along the borders with Pakistan
during the last three years and in the current
year;
(b) the details of security personnel and
other civilians killed in ceasefire violations
by Pakistani forces; and
(c) the details of ex-gratia amount
announced and paid, year-wise to
dependants of victims of ceasefire violations
by Pakistan?

301
Compensation to farmers of Punjab
1283. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state whether any
norms have been set to pay compensation
to farmers of  Punjab where lands have
been taken over for defence purposes
including the agriculture lands destroyed
during firing across the border?
India-Russia inter-Governmental
agreement on mega-project
1284. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of  DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
Russia had signed an inter-Governmental
agreement for a mega project in 2007, if so,
the details thereof;
(b) whether the project has been stuck
for the last eleven years due to differences
between two sides on sharing the cost of
developing  jets and if so, the details thereof;
and
(c) whether any time line has been fixed
about the number of jets to be produced,
the latest status, the details thereof?
Pension criterion for army jawans
1285. DR. BANDA PRAKASH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a new proposal has been
mooted by the personnel section of the
Army which requires jawans to put in more
number of years into service and also a
change in pension rules;
(b) whether One Rank One Pension
(OROP) scheme led to a spike in the number
of troops seeking premature retirement; and
(c) whether the minimum qualifying
service for pension has been raised from
fifteen years to twenty years of service?
Progress in production of Tejas
aircraft
1286. DR. BANDA PRAKASH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the indigenous Tejas fighter,
first approved way back in 1983, after
several target revisions, has missed yet
another deadline to become fully combat-
ready;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor along with the steps taken
to fast track the production and time frame
given for final operational clearance (FOC);
(c) the steps taken by Government to
meet the shortage of aircraft carriers; and
(d) the steps taken to enhance the
production of indigenous aircraft?
Strategic Partnership Policy
1287. SHRI MANISH GUPTA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the "Strategic Partnership"
(SP) policy to boost the Indian private
sectors role in production of military
hardware in collaboration with global
armament majors has become operational,
and, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether there is a delay in
operationalising the SP model and whether
this has affected adversely the status of
preparedness of the Armed Forces;
(c) whether the model suffers from lack
of clarity and transparency, if so, the details
thereof; and
(d) the segments which are likely to be

302
taken up for execution through the "SP"
route?
Defence projects under 'Make in
India' Programme
1288. SHRI MANISH GUPTA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that no defence
projects have been taken up under the
"Make in India" framework during the last
four years, and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether these delays render India
strategically vulnerable and also
disadvantaged in being greatly dependent
on large military hardware imports, and if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government has formulated
any "Defence Production Policy" to herald
a new era in providing domestically
manufactured Military Hardware for the
Indian Armed Forces, and if so, the details
thereof?
